liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (5 reviews): Reviewer was struck that China Cat into Rider closed the first set; recalls getting the tape that week, Derby weekend; Reviewer says the China>Rider first-set closer sparkled [12][14][15][17][20]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Reviewer admits being in the minority but loves the Black Muddy River encore [12]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer singles out this song as excellent [13]
- **Playin' In The Band Jam** (1 review): Reviewer likes the Playin' into Eyes pairing in the second set [18]
- **I Will Take You Home** (1 review): Reviewer could do without this song but still rates the second set highly [18]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer finds Peggy-O sweet, leading through They Love Each Other and The Race Is On into Queen Jane [20]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Not Fade Away huge [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-05-06 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t03 Peggy O**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t04 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t05 They Love Each Other**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t06 The Race Is On**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t07 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-05-06 t08 Just A Little Light**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-05-06.142355.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 177 min [1]
- **gd89-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.14262.sbefixed.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 166 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the soundboard's strong highs and lows, and says Brent is prominent and playing well [15]
- **gd1989-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.tetzeli.fix-14262.34769.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 167 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd89-05-06.dsbd.serifin.5423.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 26 songs; 166 min; rated 4.04/5 by 23 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says soundboards from this run set a reference standard for quality and dynamics, ideal played loud on a good stereo; Reviewer calls this copy fantastic sounding; Reviewer says the recording needs no EQ adjustment on an iPod to sound right [11][12][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls a lovely day at the Frost, relaxed family-style crowd with old friends, feeling like a big backyard party [13]
- Reviewer was 16 and couldn't get in, but the parking lot raged with vehicles blasting the radio broadcast across the lot [14]
- Reviewer suggests it was Derby day, judging by The Race Is On being played [18]
- Reviewer recommends also downloading the 5-7-89 show [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-05-06.142355.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB) Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2 mics > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Master Dat (Sony… [1]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps microphones, using CMC4 capsules [1]
- **gd89-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.14262.sbefixed.shnf**: source: shntool fixed shns of Jay Serafin dsbd seed [4]
- **gd1989-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.tetzeli.fix-14262.34769.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 14262 [5]. Also: Transition between CDs 2 and 3 was made seamless, with SBE errors fixed using shntool; Overlapping fade tracks were added at the end of CD 2 and start of CD 3; remove them for gapless playback [5]
- **gd89-05-06.dsbd.serifin.5423.sbefail.shnf**: source: DSBD [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-05-07 Frost Amphitheatre, Palo Alto, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-05-07-frost-amphitheatre-palo-alto-ca-usa/) [27]
